LanguageData.LP_Class_Wizard.label: wizard
LanguageData.LP_Class_Wizard.description: A scholar of arcane magic with the widest spellbook: fireballs, teleports, control.\nPower: arcane power (Intelligence, Intellectual); damage and healing also scale with psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.LP_Class_Cleric.label: cleric
LanguageData.LP_Class_Cleric.description: A god's voice: the core of healing, revival and turning undead.\nPower: divine power (Wisdom or Charisma, Social); damage and healing also scale with psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.LP_Class_Druid.label: druid
LanguageData.LP_Class_Druid.description: A guardian of nature who tames beasts, shapeshifts, grows plants and calls storms.\nPower: beast abilities use primal power (Wisdom, Animals); plant and weather abilities use verdant power (Wisdom, Plants). Liches cannot become druids.
LanguageData.LP_Class_Sorcerer.label: sorcerer
LanguageData.LP_Class_Sorcerer.description: A caster born with magic who reshapes spells with metamagic for big bursts.\nPower: charm abilities use innate power (Charisma, Social); elemental abilities use arcane power (Intelligence, Intellectual). Races with sorcerous blood are stronger.
